title: Lipschitz Pruning (Barbier et al., Eurographics 2025) — code: github.com/wbrbr/LipschitzPruning
takeaway: Per-cell active-node lists from one evaluation at the cell centre: a smooth-min branch can be dropped when |a−b| > 2R + k; cells far from the surface keep only a constant bound. 4³→256³ hierarchy; ~6 nodes per near-surface cell; 9.4 s → 29 ms on thousands of primitives.

title: Accelerating SDFs with proxy + continuous-LOD nodes (Hubert-Brierre et al., CGF 2025)
takeaway: Bounding proxies and LOD nodes inside the tree, used under a distance-dependent error gate; up to ×400 on big trees. For Clay: proxies per group, coarse polyline for far sweeps.

title: Claybook (Aaltonen, GDC 2018) — SDF in volume textures
takeaway: The field is baked into volume textures with mips and traced cone-style; edits re-bake locally. Clay's field is static between releases, so a bake is paid once per edit.

title: Dreams (Media Molecule, Evans SIGGRAPH 2015)
takeaway: Evaluate the edit list per brick only where the surface passes, cull edits per brick; display from the cache, not by re-evaluating the full list per pixel.

title: Enhanced sphere tracing (Keinert et al. 2014)
takeaway: Over-relaxed steps (ω≈1.2–1.6) with fallback cut steps 20–40% on smooth fields.

title: ANGLE → Metal translation (ANGLE source)
takeaway: mediump is fp32 on Metal; dynamic array indexing is clamped and shared globals live in a struct passed by reference; loops ANGLE can't prove finite get a volatile store per iteration.

title: Apple: Optimize Metal performance for Apple silicon (WWDC)
takeaway: Peak register use sets occupancy (A15/A16); specialising an uber-shader cut a pass 58 → 12.5 ms by removing spills; 32-wide SIMD groups.

title: three.js docs: uniforms vs defines
takeaway: Uniform changes never recompile; defines do and are cached per define set — use defines only for structural changes on release.

title: WebKit GPU watchdog / context loss
takeaway: No documented timeout; long command buffers are killed. Flush per band, keep each submission < ~50–100 ms. No timer queries on iOS: use fences over repeated draws.

title: Internal audit of raymarch.ts (this repo)
takeaway: map() inlined 3×, each with 3 sdObj and 4 sdLocal sites (~230 texture-sample sites); sweepAll evaluates sweeps the program then discards; rayMask twice per pixel; sdCached misses so unitDepth re-evaluates; dead uniforms.

title: Agentic hill-climbing brief (autoresearch, FunSearch, AlphaEvolve, EUREKA, FrameForge)
takeaway: A frozen evaluator, one scalar under hard floors, keep only past the noise band with a confirmation run, journal every attempt; track scaling exponent b and N_max, steps/ray and evals/step apart; anti-cheat gates.

title: Claybook GDC 2018 deck
takeaway: 8-bit +-4 voxel band SDF; per-8^3-tile culled brush lists at bake; no per-pixel CSG; geometric-series last step from 2 samples; sparse atlas measured 13% slower

title: Claybook sparse volume test
takeaway: Only ~10% of 8^3 tiles occupied; indirection+atlas costs ~13% per step

title: Dreams SIGGRAPH 2015 (Evans)
takeaway: fp16 8^3-ish blocks updated incrementally; brick engine rasterises brick cubes so no inner-loop indirection; compact poly smin enables >99% culling

title: Dreams soft-blend culling
takeaway: smin must revert to hard min beyond r; culling must include future blend radius of ancestors

title: Path Tracing of SDF Grids (JCGT 2022)
takeaway: Trilinear voxel = cubic along ray, analytic solve; blended analytic normals fix voxel-face normal discontinuities; 8^3 bricks with duplicated border, 8-bit snorm

title: Lipschitz Pruning paper
takeaway: Up to 629x on 6023 nodes; gains scale with node count, ~2-4x for ~6 objects

title: Lipschitz pruning meshing extension
takeaway: 5.6-7.5 active nodes/cell at 256^3; incremental re-prune 107->6.8 ms

title: Keeter MPR 2020
takeaway: Per-tile interval arithmetic tape shortening 64^2->8^2 pixel tiles on GPU

title: GPU Gems 2 ch20 fast tricubic
takeaway: Tricubic B-spline in 8 trilinear fetches, derivatives with more fetch sets; smooth bake normals

title: Piecewise SDF analytic intersections
takeaway: Trilinear for hit, tricubic for normals at small overhead

title: Texture gathers and coordinate precision
takeaway: HW filtering has ~8 fractional bits; manual fp32 interpolation removes banding

title: WebKit bug 252359
takeaway: iOS Safari misreported OES_texture_float_linear; use half-float for linear sampling

title: WebKit bug 282111
takeaway: Oct 2024: iOS Safari still lacks OES_texture_float_linear

title: ANGLE Metal format map / DisplayMtl
takeaway: 8 draw buffers on Apple family 2+; max3DTextureSize 2048; R32F filterable only Apple7+ with supports32BitFloatFiltering

title: metal-benchmarks (Apple GPU microarch)
takeaway: 12 KB I-cache, 8 KB L1D per core; prefers spilling to lowering occupancy; small shaders win

title: Reverse reprojection caching (Nehab 2007)
takeaway: Cache intermediate per-pixel results (t, normal) and reuse when valid

title: Temporal depth reprojection for raymarching
takeaway: Rotation-only reprojection works; translation needs conservative march from dilated old depth

title: Water from still photo (march cache)
takeaway: Precompute and reuse march results while view is fixed

title: Bevy deferred raymarch
takeaway: SDF hit into G-buffer, shaded like a mesh

title: Browser isosurface study
takeaway: MC 256^3 ~228-282 ms serial JS/WASM; data-parallel 1.3x

title: fast-surface-nets-rs
takeaway: ~20M tris/s/core, chunked with seamless stitching; WASM-able

title: fastNaiveSurfaceNets
takeaway: 0.1-0.4 ms per 32^3 chunk single-thread

title: Substance Modeler how it works
takeaway: SDF sculpting app renders polygons in viewport (8^3 blocks, MC)

title: Womp pixel streaming
takeaway: Womp renders server-side; nothing to copy

title: Brixelizer
takeaway: R8_UNORM 3D atlas + uint brick map, 64^3 cascades

title: Wicked Engine normal from depth
takeaway: Best-triangle depth normals; edge-safe but depth-precision-limited

title: atyuwen accurate normal reconstruction
takeaway: 5 taps/axis, ~9 fetches; fails under ~3px features

title: SwiftShader SamplerCore
takeaway: Software sampler: fetch-heavy tricks under-rewarded on the headless proxy

title: RTSDF
takeaway: SDF banding from low res and fixed steps; jitter + TAA
